description: DS18B20 1-Wire on PB12 (open drain + external 4.7k pull-up, DWT slot timing): READ ROM at boot, then CONVERT T / READ SCRATCHPAD with CRC8 every second; prints the temperature and the conversion time on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. PB12 open-drain output idling released, DWT->CYCCNT slot timing with interrupts masked per slot. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'DS18B20 on PB12 (1-Wire, DWT timing)
', then a reset (500 us low, presence sampled at 70 us, 430 us tail) and READ ROM: 'ROM 28-..-..-..-..-..-..-<crc> CRC ok
'. Every 1000 ms (first right after boot): reset, SKIP ROM, CONVERT T, read slots until a 1 (12 bit: 750 ms), reset, SKIP ROM, READ SCRATCHPAD, 9 bytes, CRC8 over bytes 0-7 checked; prints 'T=[-]<C>.<dddd> C (conv <ms> ms)
' with T = (int16)(b1 << 8 | b0) / 16. Before every reset the released line must read high: without the pull-up (or with DQ shorted low) it prints '1-Wire bus low: missing 4.7k pull-up?
'; a pulled-up bus without a sensor prints 'no DS18B20 (no presence pulse)
'; a bad CRC 'scratchpad CRC error
'; a conversion that never ends 'conversion timeout
'.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
no DS18B20 on the bus (tests/devices/sensors-firmware.test.ts wires one instead)

boot.USART1:
DS18B20 on PB12 (1-Wire, DWT timing)
no DS18B20 (no presence pulse)
no DS18B20 (no presence pulse)
